annotations.title: Send a booking request to a club

description: Send a booking request to a club whose card says booking.requests_enabled is true. golfdata only FORWARDS the request to the club (by email, or a WhatsApp click-to-chat link) and does NOT confirm the booking. Returns a request id and, for the whatsapp channel, a tracked link. For a club that is not enabled it returns accepted: false. You must have the golfer's consent before sending their name, email or phone. The golfer's details are forwarded to the club and kept for 24 months, then anonymized; a golfer can ask to erase them sooner by writing to hello@golfdata.online.

club_id.description: Club UUID (from get_club or the card).

email.description: The golfer's email (with their consent); used as reply-to, never shared beyond the club.

phone.description: The golfer's phone in E.164, e.g. +34600123456 (with their consent).

name: request_booking
title: Send a booking request to a club
